| 1 | 110 | "found the world" | "found the world" | "found their way in the world" | *he eurē ton kosmon*: literal vs. paraphrase |
| 2 | 110 | "renounce the world" | "renounce the world" | "give it all up" | *bōl ebol*: renounce vs. give up |
